name: Design Challenges
description: Build within a constraint, discover a new possibility, and explain your choices.

cards.title: Harder, same cast
cards.task: Make an encounter harder without adding enemies or new rules. Change existing parameter values or spatial relationships. Name the skill you are challenging.
cards.reflection: What made the encounter harder, and how can a playtest check that claim?

cards.title: One ingredient, three difficulties
cards.task: Build easy, medium, and hard versions using one ingredient type. Keep the objective and core rules constant; explain the parameter values in each version.
cards.reflection: What evidence would show a gradual progression rather than three arbitrary labels?

cards.title: Teach without a speech
cards.task: Build a short introduction that lets a new player discover one rule through a safe action, then demonstrate understanding in a second situation.
cards.reflection: What signs and feedback make the rule understandable? Where did testers hesitate?

cards.title: Two ways through
cards.task: Create an encounter with at least two meaningfully different solutions. Make each solution involve a distinct trade-off.
cards.reflection: Why would different players choose different solutions?

cards.title: A tempting detour
cards.task: Offer a safe route to the goal and an optional risky route with a desirable reward. Make the risk visible before the commitment.
cards.reflection: Can a player make an informed choice? Is the reward worth the added risk?

cards.title: Less to work with
cards.task: Remove one tool or mechanic from a familiar scenario. Redesign the layout so it remains solvable and invites a different strategy.
cards.reflection: What changed in the player's reasoning rather than just the number of available actions?

cards.title: Unexpected partners
cards.task: Use two existing ingredient types to create a decision neither creates alone. Keep their individual rules unchanged.
cards.reflection: What new interaction emerges from the combination?

cards.title: One tile matters
cards.task: Change only one tile, path connection, or object position. Make that single change alter the best strategy.
cards.reflection: Why does this location have such a large effect on the player's options?

cards.title: Teach, practise, combine
cards.task: Create three short encounters: introduce one idea safely, practise it with a stronger demand, then combine it with an already understood idea.
cards.reflection: What does each encounter prepare the player to do next?

cards.title: Fair warning
cards.task: Create a dangerous encounter whose threat is readable before the player enters it. Use facing, layout, light, or a clearly stated visual sign.
cards.reflection: Can a first-time player explain the danger before experiencing failure?

cards.title: Same rules, new world
cards.task: Reskin an existing mechanic into a different fiction while preserving its rules, parameter values, and possible actions.
cards.reflection: Which presentation helps the player understand the function more quickly?

cards.title: Spend it wisely
cards.task: Give the player a limited resource and at least two useful ways to spend it. Make both choices viable under the stated rules.
cards.reflection: What information does the player need to make this choice deliberately?
